title: Harden resumable publication flow
body:
## Summary

- Added selected-path security scanning before staging and blocked required security failures.
- Moved publication into isolated task worktrees with persisted runtime state after irreversible actions.
- Added resume/idempotency handling for commit, push, and PR publication plus regression coverage.

## Checks

- PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest tests
- make validate-artifacts
- make security
- make check
